'''Chapter 136''' is titled "A Man Named Dalton".

==Cover Page==
[[Jango's Dance Paradise]], Vol. 9: "Ah! The Marines".

To his horror, [[Jango]] finds the [[Marines]] have already tracked him to [[Mirror Ball Island]], and are showing his [[Bounties|wanted poster]] to the locals.

==Short Summary==
[[Dalton]] attacks [[Wapol]] but is tricked by his good feelings. The [[Animal Species/Arabasta Saga#Lapahn|lapahn]], not able to catch [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Sanji]] start an avalanche.

==Long Summary==
[[Wapol]] threatens the inhabitants of [[Bighorn]]. he demands they accept him as their king once more. When he learns from his crewmates that the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] are nearby, he swears to get revenge. His men spot his castle is intact and that Dr. [[Kureha]] is living in it. Wapol is surprised and he decides to take it back and to take his revenge.

However, his plan is halted by [[Dalton]] who has run towards his village. He delivers a critical hit Wapol. However, the former King has a highly skilled personal medical team, the [[Isshi-100|Isshi-20]]. It is revealed that Wapol got rid of every doctor in [[Drum Island|Drum]], beside the 20 best ones whom only works for him. Due to the medical notoriety of the town, when people could no longer get treatment due to the monopoly of medical services, the town was abandoned by the medical professionals.

This act of selfishness and the cowardice he has shown is unforgivable to Dalton. As he is about to attack Wapol again, [[Chess]] and [[Kuromarimo]] threaten they know him too well. They attack the citizens who had come to help Dalton. In order to protect the villagers, Dalton sacrifices himself and takes the arrows directly in his chest.

Meanwhile, the angry [[Animal Species/Arabasta Saga#Lapahn|lapahn]] chase [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Sanji]]. But, they are unable to catch them and act strangely by jumping on the ground. Soon, a giant avalanche begins to rush down the mountain, putting everyone in danger.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Jango]] has a [[bounty]] of {{B}}9,000,000.
*Wapol is revealed to have exiled all doctors just to keep his personal [[Isshi-100|Isshi-20]] to control the people's lives through their health.
*[[Dalton]] ate the [[Ushi Ushi no Mi, Model: Bison]].
*This is the first time that the term '[[Zoan]]' is used for a [[Devil Fruit]].
